column1: # manifests/mcp.tsv — MCP servers, installed with each agent's native CLI.
# name
#   name       The server name in every agent's config. Set here, never on the
#              command line: three `codex mcp add copilotkit …` calls with three
#              different URLs left Codex holding only the last one.
#   transport  stdio — target is an npm package run under `npx -y`, optionally
#              followed by single-spaced arguments, which entries must match.
#              http / sse — target is a URL. Codex and Antigravity have no SSE
#              client, so an `sse` row naming them is refused.
#   agents     claude-code, codex, opencode, github-copilot, antigravity, or *
#              for every one of them installed on the host. Copilot and
#              Antigravity are optional.
# This file is the core every host gets; profiles and the user's own rows add to it.
# Documentation for the cloud CLIs setup.sh installs. No sign-in.
aws-knowledge
microsoft-learn
cloudflare-docs
# Browser checks with console and network logs. Both start Chrome when used.
# chrome-devtools-mcp sends usage statistics to Google unless told not to.
chrome-devtools
playwright
